cause: Tangent Hub retained an abandoned Autodesk Flare connection held open by Autodesk background processes and routed the knob to it instead of the new Flame session.
repair: Closed only the obsolete loopback Tangent TCP connection from port 58486 to 64246 using ss -K, after confirming no live Flame/Flare process owned it.
operator_result: All three work now: Jog, tap-to-Play, hold-to-Stop
recurrence: A future application exit/logout may leave inherited sockets again; identify obsolete sockets by current process ownership before closing them. Do not hardcode recorded ports/PIDs.
